title: 27 April – State Flag Day of the Republic of Moldova!
excerpt: We express our honour and historic gratitude to the State Flag of the Republic of Moldova!
body_html:
We express our honour and historic gratitude to the State Flag of the Republic of Moldova, which today, 27 April, marks 34 years since it was enshrined in law. It was on 27 April 1990 that “the unanimous view was shared that the return of the tricolour and its symbolism, at a time of renewal of our society, comes from the enduring consciousness and spirituality of our people, and that accepting and recognising it would be nothing other than an act of historical justice”.

Our flag is a symbol linking the past, the present and the future, and it reminds us of the supreme sacrifices made so that today we have a democratic state in which fundamental human rights are protected and the principles of the rule of law are respected.

Celebrating State Flag Day of the Republic of Moldova, as a symbol of peace, freedom and security, obliges us to pass on to the younger generations, through personal example, a sense of belonging to our cultural and national values — and the understanding that patriotism is not only the emotion of a holiday but taking responsibility for contributing to the development of this country.

May this day give everyone strength and confidence in reaching their goals for the good of our country, and may the Flag of the Republic of Moldova fly over a prosperous and strong country!

Happy birthday, Republic of Moldova!

Happy State Flag Day of the Republic of Moldova!
